description: Two catalogs in DIFFERENT languages (de, en) with fallbackLocale en, so the candidate chain's length is decided entirely by the requested locale: requesting de builds [de, en] and gives exactly one policy consultation, requesting en builds [en] and gives none. That contrast is what makes a null-returning policy's rejection attributable to the CONSULTATION rather than to its installation. The instance handler is return-key and the instance policy is any-failure, both benign, so every case's per-call override is the only variable. Present.De and Present.En exist so a translated lookup can be observed on the same fixture; no key is present in both, and Missing.Everywhere is present in neither.
